quote.translation: As we can gather from the fact that, among the forms of categorical contingency, exceptional contingency has a contingency of particular prominence, the core meaning of categorical contingency came down in the end to "the individual thing and the individual event" over against the general concept.

regions.text: 次に假説偶然は理由性の假説構造の有つ同一必然性に對して、斯かる構の園外にあるものが示す偶然性であつた。

quote.translation: Hypothetical contingency, next, was the contingency shown by what lies outside the sphere of the hypothetical structure of groundedness, over against the identical necessity which that structure possesses.

regions.text: 純論理範園に於ては理由偶然として現はれ、經驗界にあつては理由約偶然の適用の形で目前々偶然および因果偶然として現ばれた。假説的偶然のこの三様態は更に各々消極偶然を積極的偶然とに分れた。

quote.translation: In the purely logical range it appeared as contingency of ground, and in the empirical world, in the form of an application of contingency of ground, as teleological and causal contingency, and each of these three modes of hypothetical contingency divided further into negative and positive contingency.

regions.text: 消極的偶然は一つの事象に開して理由性、因果性、目性の非存在が清極に目撃される場合であり積極前偶然は二つまた

quote.translation: Negative contingency is the case in which, with regard to a single event, the non-existence of groundedness, causality or purposiveness is negatively witnessed.

regions.text: 二つ以上の事象間に理由性因果性、目的性の假説必然闘係の非存在を見るのみならず更に進んで積極的に他の何等かの開係の存在を目業する場合である。

quote.translation: Positive contingency is the case in which, between two or more events, we not only see the non-existence of a hypothetical necessary relation of groundedness, causality or purposiveness, but go further and positively witness the existence of some other relation.

regions.text: 横極約偶然はその積極性によつて滑極的偶然よりも題著な偶然性を示してる.る。のみならず消極偶然の根柢にはまた必ず何等かの積極偶然が存してあるものである。

quote.translation: By virtue of its positivity, positive contingency shows a more marked contingency than negative contingency, and at the root of negative contingency some positive contingency is, moreover, always present.

quote.translation: Insofar as it has the character of relative contingency, positive contingency shows the structure of "the Encounter of one series with another series", and this structure was indeed the core meaning of hypothetical contingency.
